rationale: Reviewed the proposed reference against the original notebook narrative and the untouched converted baseline, cell by cell. Every scientific branch and endpoint is preserved: two-sample 10X loading and concat (s1d1 8785 / s1d3 8340 confirmed in the prior execution log), mt/ribo/hb QC metrics with log1p variants (pre-filter obs exported before filtering, matching the violin/scatter endpoints), filter_cells(min_genes=100)/filter_genes(min_cells=3), scrublet(batch_key="sample"), counts layer + median normalize_total + log1p, HVG(n_top_genes=2000, batch_key="sample"), PCA (coords, variance ratios, loadings in h5ad), neighbors/UMAP, Leiden at default igraph/n_iterations=2 and resolutions 0.02/0.50/2.00, cell_type_lvl1 mapping, and Wilcoxon rank_genes_groups for every cluster including the group "7" top-5 (NKG7/GNLY) and dc_cluster_genes endpoints. All source plotting calls remain intact and executed. The source diff contains only three faithful input-staging edits (os import; pooch DOI registry replaced by an explanatory comment; loading the MD5/size/SHA-256-verified staged originals from /inputs) and six read-only export additions (obs/var CSVs, PCA coords + variance ratios, UMAP coords, full DEG table via scanpy's own getter, final obs CSV + h5ad). No parameters, formulas, labels, thresholds or seeds were changed; no branch skipped, no error suppressed; exports do not modify analysis state; the h5ad compression drop is an export-format choice with identical data. The setup script performs environment reconstruction and input staging only (POSIX set -eu after the dash/pipefail failure, scikit-image added for scrublet's automatic threshold after the prior ValueError — an environment gap, not a source change), verifies the exact original input files against provider MD5s, records resolved versions, and runs no analysis. Exclusions (rendered figures, the exact-duplicate UMAP cell 55, transient dotplot group statistics recoverable from adata_final.h5ad's full X plus cluster labels, loadings kept inside the h5ad) are reasonable and explicitly mapped. Three defect lists are empty: no omitted scientific results, no prohibited scientific changes, no known setup or export problems. Residual uncertainties are recorded as execution checks (runtime budget after the scrublet failure, uns['pca']['variance_ratio'] access, presence of >=8 clusters for the group 7 endpoint).
